features.name: total_policy_contribution_intensity
features.description: Sum of all contribution levels across non-mobile-home policy types, log-scaled for SVM stability. Captures overall insurance engagement.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a smooth continuous measure of total insurance spending propensity that linear SVM can use as a strong margin signal.
features.formula: np.log1p(contributionThirdPartyInsuranceFirms + contributionThirdPartyInsuranceAgriculture + contributionCarPolicies + contributionDeliveryVanPolicies + contributionMotorcycleScooterPolicies + contributionLorryPolicies + contributionTrailerPolicies + contributionTractorPolicies + contributionAgriculturalMachinesPolicies + contributionMopedPolicies + contributionLifeInsurances + contributionPrivateAccidentInsurancePolicies + contributionFamilyAccidentsInsurancePolicies + contributionDisabilityInsurancePolicies + contributionFirePolicies + contributionSurfboardPolicies + contributionBoatPolicies + contributionBicyclePolicies + contributionPropertyInsurancePolicies + contributionSocialSecurityInsurancePolicies)

features.name: total_policy_count_intensity
features.description: Log-scaled total number of policies held across all categories, indicating breadth of insurance ownership.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth count aggregation gives the linear SVM a robust feature for distinguishing high-engagement customers.
features.formula: np.log1p(numberOfPrivateThirdPartyInsurance + numberOfThirdPartyInsuranceFirms + numberOfThirdPartyInsuranceAgriculture + numberOfCarPolicies + numberOfDeliveryVanPolicies + numberOfMotorcycleScooterPolicies + numberOfLorryPolicies + numberOfTrailerPolicies + numberOfTractorPolicies + numberOfAgriculturalMachinesPolicies + numberOfMopedPolicies + numberOfLifeInsurances + numberOfPrivateAccidentInsurancePolicies + numberOfFamilyAccidentsInsurancePolicies + numberOfDisabilityInsurancePolicies + numberOfFirePolicies + numberOfSurfboardPolicies + numberOfBoatPolicies + numberOfBicyclePolicies + numberOfPropertyInsurancePolicies + numberOfSocialSecurityInsurancePolicies)

features.name: affluence_composite_score
features.description: Weighted composite of socioeconomic status indicators: income, purchasing power, high status, home ownership, and high education.
features.expected_model_benefit: Linear projection of correlated affluence variables into a single smooth axis useful for SVM margins.

features.name: rural_agrarian_signal
features.description: Composite indicator combining farmer occupation, agriculture-related insurance contributions and counts to capture rural lifestyle.
features.expected_model_benefit: Mobile home ownership tends to correlate with rural/agrarian segments; a smooth composite aids linear separation.

features.name: homeownership_to_rent_ratio
features.description: Smoothed ratio of homeowners to rented housing in customer's zone, indicating residential stability.
features.expected_model_benefit: Ratio features provide scale-invariant signals; smoothing avoids divide-by-zero for stable linear coefficients.

features.name: family_household_score
features.description: Composite score reflecting family-with-children household structure relative to singles/childless households.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures family-orientation as a continuous axis useful for SVM margin construction.
features.formula: householdWithChildren + married + avgSizeHousehold - singles - householdWithoutChildren - livingTogether

features.name: car_ownership_intensity
features.description: Weighted car ownership level (two cars weighted higher), normalized by absence of car.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth vehicle-ownership axis relevant for insurance customer profiling.

features.name: fire_property_policy_signal
features.description: Combined intensity of fire and property insurance ownership (often correlated with home/mobile home insurance).
features.expected_model_benefit: Fire/property holdings are conceptually adjacent to mobile home insurance; linear combo gives discriminative margin.

features.name: education_status_gap
features.description: Difference between high education+status and lower education levels, signed continuous social-class projection.
features.expected_model_benefit: Signed continuous axis with both polarities helps linear SVM separate strata.

features.name: houses_per_household_size
features.description: Number of houses scaled by household size; deviation from typical 1-house-per-household norm.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures unusual housing patterns (multiple properties or large households) as a smooth signal.

features.name: religiosity_homogeneity
features.description: Semantic judgment of religious community concentration: higher when a single religious group dominates the customer's zone (catholic, protestant, or other) vs. mixed/secular composition. Computed as the maximum of protestant, otherReligion, and a numeric proxy for romanCatholic category divided by the sum, scaled.
features.expected_model_benefit: Cohesive religious communities often align with traditional household choices; gives SVM a normalized smooth dimension.

features.name: lifestage_traditionalism_score
features.description: Semantic assessment of how 'traditional/settled' a customer's life stage is, based on avgAge band (40-70 weighted higher), customerMainType (e.g., Conservative/Retired/Family weighted higher), and married level. Continuous score reflecting traditional lifestyle.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a smoothly normalized lifestyle axis combining multiple categorical and ordinal cues for linear SVM separation.
